record_type_quote: A genetic association study was performed to investigate the association between XbaI SNP in ESR1 and the predisposition for, or progression of, AIS in Caucasian patients.

targets.authors: Inoue M Minami S Nakata Y Kitahara H Otsuka Y Isobe K Takaso M Tokunaga M Nishikawa S Maruta T Moriya H
targets.title: Association between estrogen receptor gene polymorphisms and curve severity of idiopathic scoliosis
targets.evidence_quote: It has been suggested that XbaI single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) (A/G rs934099) in estrogen receptor 1 (ESR1) may be associated with curve severity in Japanese AIS patients[ 1 ] and with both curve severity and predisposition for AIS in Chinese patients[ 2 ]. However, replication studies have not confirmed these findings[ 3 ]. The role of the XbaI ESR1 polymorphism rs9340799 in AIS has never been described in Caucasian AIS patients.
targets.outcome_quote: No association between ESR1 XbaI polymorphism and AIS was found in the Caucasian population. None of the previously reported associations with curve severity, progression or operation rate could be confirmed.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The abstract tests the previously reported ESR1 XbaI associations in a new Caucasian sample and explicitly states that no association was found and none of the prior associations could be confirmed.
